title: Love Never Gives Up
story:
Two brothers were building a small tower with wooden blocks.

The younger brother accidentally knocked it down just when they were almost finished.

The older brother became frustrated and wanted to stop.

But after seeing his younger brother's sad face, he decided to help him build it again.

This time, he showed him how to place the blocks carefully and patiently.

Together, they rebuilt the tower, and the younger brother was happy that his brother had not given up on him.

True love is not only shown through kind words or happy moments.

Love is patient when someone makes mistakes.

Love is kind when others are difficult to deal with.

Love does not become jealous, proud, or selfish.

It does not keep a record of every wrong or seek revenge.

Love chooses to forgive, protect, trust, and hope.

In our families, friendships, workplaces, and churches, there will be moments when people disappoint us.

God calls us to respond with the kind of love that reflects His character.

This does not mean accepting wrongdoing or allowing ourselves to be harmed.

It means choosing patience, kindness, forgiveness, and truth instead of anger, pride, and selfishness.

When we allow God's love to guide our actions, our relationships can become places where His grace is seen.

Ask God today to help you love others not only when it is easy, but especially when it is difficult.
life_lesson: Real love is patient, kind, forgiving, and selfless. Let God's love shape the way you treat others, especially when they disappoint or hurt you.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for loving me with a love that never fails.

Teach me to love others with patience and kindness.

Help me not to become proud, jealous, selfish, or easily angered.

Give me the grace to forgive those who hurt or disappoint me.

Help me to speak truth with love and to treat others with respect and compassion.

When loving someone becomes difficult, remind me of the love You have shown me.

Help me to protect, trust, hope, and persevere in love.

May my words and actions reflect Your love wherever I go.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Is there someone you find difficult to love patiently and kindly?

Are you holding on to anger or keeping a record of someone's past mistakes?

What is one loving action you can take toward someone today?
verse: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud. It does not dishonor others, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no record of wrongs. Love does not delight in evil but rejoices with the truth. It always protects, always trusts, always hopes, always perseveres.
